_comment: BrainQuest vault config — the single source of truth for WHERE the vault is and HOW to read it (path, harvested headings, tag scheme, tutor areas). Read-only — the app never writes here. Override the path per-machine with the BRAINQUEST_VAULT_PATH env var (the repo is synced via GitHub, so this absolute path is machine-specific). Point BrainQuest at another brain by editing the values below; any omitted section falls back to the vault defaults baked into lib/vault/config.ts.
